summary:
44x32 McMansion: a garage wing (x1..17) and a main block (x18..35) with a two-storey quartz portico under a tall cross-gable, plus a hipped family wing (x35..42) with a conical turret bay, all in dark-slate roofs.
Stone veneer lower front, birch siding above, quartz belt courses and quoins, black shutter strips, a 3x2 stone chimney, a wide driveway and a lawn with shrubs and a young tree, and a back deck.
17 rooms with exact boxes (foyer with an oak stair and a double-height void, upper gallery, bonus room over the garage); 6 parts, 36 ticked elements.

main shell: P1 main shell built in parts/main-shell.mjs: M, W and turret T walls y0..9 (plinth, veneer, siding, belt y5/y9), floors with foyer void, top plate, partitions, foyer oak stair, quoins and shutters, all OPENINGS left as air. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; the P1 line shows 1825 placed, no REFUSED and no OFF-PALETTE; mcd check reports 0 floating and walkable end to end.
Render (front-left, front elevation) reads as a two-storey block with belt rows, stone lower front, shutters; garage/roof/facade are absent because those parts are still stubs.
Plan.md checklist P1 ticked; plan Notes records the stair facing and the x>=18 quoin filter.
polish: Stair facing: plan.md says facing=south for the foyer stair, but the k-steps rise south from z12 to z16, so the open front is north; built facing=north (noted in plan.md Notes). Confirm with a render of the foyer interior if the stair reads wrong.

Turret cone roof (element 3), entry gable roof, the foyer stair banister, and every window glazing, arch, sill, hood, entry door and fanlight (elements 6, 14) are later parts' (P3/P4); P1 left those openings as air.
Garage corner quoins and shutters (x<18) are P2's; P1 skipped them so P2 can build them.
Not run: `mcd walk` with rooms.json (plan checklist last item); it needs the other parts built.
